occurrences.source: GSI Misc. Pub. No. 30 Pt. 22 / CMPDI Coal Inventory / SCCL Lease Registry
occurrences.verification_method: Statutory Colliery Mining Lease Boundary Survey & Published GSI Coal Wing Memoirs

occurrences.name: Kothagudem Coal Belt

occurrences.name: Ramagundam Coal Belt

occurrences.name: Jharia Prime Coking Coal Basin

occurrences.name: Korba Coalfield (Gevra / Kusmunda / Dipka)

occurrences.verification_method: Published Statutory PSU Lease Boundary Survey

scientific_guidelines.explanation: Coal seams are stratified sedimentary units dipping 8°-15° under thick sandstone overburden. Surface multispectral VNIR/SWIR indicators detect excavated opencast benches and carbonaceous mine spoil; underground seams require borehole core logs and seismic profiles.
scientific_guidelines.rationale: Optical surface reflectance features alone cannot predict subsurface coal seam presence, thickness, or commercial grade. Numerical prospectivity predictions are withheld to prevent misleading greenfield seam inference.
